interpretation: Across N=300 randomized queries on a road network of 238 intersections: A* expanded an average of 59.9 nodes vs 120.1 for Dijkstra (2.01x exploration efficiency), achieving 100% identical optimal costs. Bellman-Ford was verified on 30 queries, demonstrating identical optimality but suffering a 9.7x runtime penalty due to its O(V*E) edge relaxation passes.
